messages:
Brynn (PM): folks, we need a concise operational playbook for the v1 -> v2 API transition. primary focus: chat/completions, tool calls, and embeddings. low friction for customers, minimal silent changes. who volunteers to own the doc?
Jordan (Eng): I can own the runtime checklist and the shim spec. will need perf targets and streaming parity definitions.
Manraj (Runtime): runtime notes: streaming parity must be exact chunking for client compatibility; kv-cache prefix differences could break prefix-caching; quantized fallbacks may tweak tokenization edge cases. propose perf SLO: p95 latency regression <10% and quality delta <0.5% on shared evals.
Sasha (Product Eng): api contract items: keep header compatibility (accept legacy headers), stable response fields unless explicit opt-in, and map error codes. structured-output schemas are critical for customers using strict parsers.
Diego (CSE): for enterprise and private deployments we need clear migration windows and ops steps. recommend: hosted: 90d warnings then 180d removal; dedicated: 120d default with extension options; private: min 120d vendor upgrade window. include sample curl and SDK guidance.
Ava (Legal): legal requirements: deprecation notices must be preserved in audit logs; send two business notices before any breaking removal; store templates in legal S3 and cc SOC/audit.
deploy-bot: reminder set: v2-cutover-docs review meeting on 2022-06-18 16:00 UTC in #product
Brynn (PM): proposed rollout: internal canary (48h) -> selected-customer canary (5%) -> regional ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks. feature-flagged shim during canary and ramp to collect telemetry. rollback window per stage with clear metrics gate.
Jordan (Eng): shim behavior proposal: if header `x-compat-mode: v1` present, route to legacy handling or run v2->v1 adapter; otherwise allow fallback if feature-flag triggered. when shimmed, add `compatibility_shim` object with `shimmed: true` and `reason`. shim must preserve streaming chunks and tool-call wire format.
Manraj (Runtime): telemetry contract: collect eval quality delta, p50/p95/p99 latency vs v1, error-rate spikes, downstream tool-call success rates. set anomaly alert rules: 2x baseline 5xx within 5m triggers page.
Sasha (Product Eng): launch acceptance checklist (short form):
- contract diff reviewed and signed by Product/Eng/Legal
- SDKs published with compatibility tests
- canary telemetry: quality delta <0.5% on shared evals
- p95 latency regression <10% vs v1
- rollback playbook validated in staging
- migration docs published and customer comms scheduled
Diego (CSE): migration doc should include: curl examples, SDK pinning strategy, enterprise admin checklist, and recommended opt-in process for pilots. sample snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "x-compat-mode: v1" \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v2/chat
```
Brynn (PM): action owners and target timestamps: Jordan - runtime + shim spec (ts: 2210002000) EOD+2; Manraj - telemetry + rollback playbook (ts: 2210003000) EOD+2; Sasha - contract diff + SDK notes (ts: 2210004000) EOD+3; Diego - customer migration guide (ts: 2210005000) EOD+4; Ava - legal templates (ts: 2210006000) EOD+5.
Jordan (Eng): quick clarifying Q: do we require explicit before/after examples for any tool/function-calling signature changes?
Sasha (Product Eng): yes — any breaking tool-call changes must include example payloads before/after, a migration snippet, and an automated eval run for enterprise pilot customers.
Manraj (Runtime): implementation note: will prototype shim feature-flag in staging tomorrow, plan to enable telemetry stream. will post ETA.
Diego (CSE): once draft is live I will push to top customers for feedback and track blockers.
Brynn (PM): agreed. we'll publish the migration guide draft to product docs, link the compatibility matrix, and open an escalation channel for early adopters. closing thread unless new blockers surface. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
